note: Upper bounds of work per script, recorded from the implementation. They may only go down, except when a correctness fix makes a unit honest about its presence: `invalidations` is the reverse-dependency cone (E_v), and `14632c9` made `tree_contains` answer `true` for the slots `tree_get` already read, so six dependents that were never recorded now are. `backspace`, `typing-end` and `typing-mid` moved 10 -> 16 for that reason, and the bound records the corrected cone rather than the one a wrongly-absent unit produced. `content_commits` counts whole-content values that were actually published, one per field a write group really moved. It is 6-9 for every script regardless of how much the edit touches (it was 7,051 for one byte and 6,518 for a deleted region), which is the property the plan asks for.
